 Number of local scratch buffers.
 
#define DPU_AOAPROCHWA_NUM_LOCAL_SCRATCH_BUFFER_SIZE_BYTES(numTxAntennas)    ((numTxAntennas) * DPU_AOAPROCHWA_NUM_ANGLE_BINS * sizeof(uint16_t))
 Local scratch buffer size. The size maximum of the two buffers that are overlayed: Buffer 1 (azimElevLocalBuf and azimElevLocalHypothesesBuf) size: (NTxAnt + 1) * NTxAnt * NRxAnt * sizeof(uint32_t) Buffer 2 (azimuthFftOutMagBuf) size: NTxAnt * DPU_AOAPROCHWA_NUM_ANGLE_BINS * sizeof(uint16_t) The size of the second buffer is greater than the first one as long as (NTxAnt + 1) * NRxAnt < 32, which is true, therefore the size of the second buffer is defined below. Note: For nTx*nTx*nRx*sizeof(uint32_t) == 64, this is the case where only combination that is valid is nTx = 2, nRx = 4, we do the EDMA 4K speculative correction for some devices which advances the azimElevLocalHypothesesBuf by a maximum of 64. In this case, buffer1 size = 32 + (64 + 64) = 160 buffer2 size = 256, so condition above is still true.
